description: Anima's COMPOSED serving tree: the net.* DiT beside the Qwen3-0.6B text encoder and the qwen-image VAE — what the anima endpoint binds (@composed-v3). tensorhub publishes three bf16 packagings of it (dit/, 2-shard transformer/, split_files/) and content-grouping admits all three. anima.net@1 REMAINS deliberately: it is the lone-DiT packaging upstream really ships and the anchor of the ratified anima.net-to-prefixed@1 seam — but it is not a lane; the lane pair is @2's.
name: anima.net
